milestone.description: The milestone this item is committed to. Required for ordinary work. Absent on found work until the product owner schedules it: unscheduled debt is excluded from milestone progress, and recording it never commits the project to doing it.

description.description: Optional. What the item is, in enough detail that another profile could pick it up without re-deriving it.

kind.description: What kind of work item this is. 'technical_debt' is work a profile found while doing something else and did not do — recorded per GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 8.1 rather than left as a note. Absent means 'feature'.

origin.description: Where this item came from, when it was found rather than planned. Required on a technical_debt item: found work with no traceable origin is indistinguishable from an opinion.

discovered_by.description: Canonical id of the profile that found it.

discovered_in.description: The run, step or work item it was found during.

evidence.description: Paths, artifacts or check output a reader can verify — the same evidence standard as a ledger entry.

ledger_entry.description: Optional. The finding profile's ledger entry recording the observation, if it made one. The entry says what is true; this item says what will change.

scheduled_by.description: Optional. Canonical id of the profile that scheduled this found work into a milestone. Only the product owner may: recording found work is open to every profile, prioritizing it is not.

then.description: Found work states where it came from and with what evidence.

else.description: Ordinary planned work belongs to a milestone.
